title: Majority of Americans reject Trump’s renaming of Lake Ontario to Lake America, poll finds
summary: A Reuters/Ipsos poll shows 63% of Americans oppose Trump's executive order renaming Lake Ontario to Lake America amid the U.S.-Canada trade war.

title: Progressive Florida Democrat insists Trump was pushing 'communism' with Venezuela deal
summary: Democratic Florida U.S. Senate candidate Angie Nixon accused President Donald Trump on Monday of pushing communism through his new Venezuela oil deal.

title: Trump, Schiff forge unlikely alliance as Hollywood bleeds jobs
summary: President Donald Trump and Adam Schiff find rare common ground on a federal film tax incentive to bring back Hollywood entertainment jobs lost abroad.

title: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll submits resignation to Trump
summary: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll has submitted his resignation letter to the White House, a senior U.S. official confirms. The White House has not yet accepted his resignation.

summary: Chief Justice John Roberts warned the White House ballroom project is "likely unlawful," but the Supreme Court let construction continue for now.

summary: Nicki Minaj, Grant Cardone, and Joe Gebbia will judge the SBA's Patriot Pitch as five entrepreneur finalists compete for $1 million in cash.
